data.name: Touched by Madness
data.description: Once every ten minutes, when you use steal health, you can cause the affected creature to permanently take no other action but babbling incoherently (Will DC %1) instead of taking damage.  A creature affected by this ability can be cured through the use of powerful healing such as greater restoration or heal.|TouchedByMadnessDC
